claim: The PrivateLink FAQ says you can create up to 100 VPC endpoints per VPC.
question: How many VPC endpoints can you create in a single VPC, according to the PrivateLink FAQ?

evidence.quote: You can create up to 100 VPC endpoints per VPC.

note: d11-110. The next FAQ sentence says to contact AWS if you need more. Conflicts with the quotas page: 50 interface and Gateway Load Balancer endpoints per VPC, 20 gateway endpoints per Region (see vpc-endpoints-faq-guide-quota-*).
